requirement.title: Session Timeout
requirement.text: The system shall automatically sign out an inactive user after 5 minutes.

acceptance_criteria.text: After 4 minutes of inactivity, the system displays the session timeout warning.
The warning allows the user to continue the session.
If the user remains inactive, the system automatically signs the user out after 5 minutes.

scenarios.title: Display session timeout warning
scenarios.description: Verify that an authenticated user receives the session timeout warning after 4 minutes of inactivity.
actions: Leave the session inactive for 4 minutes.
expected_results: The session timeout warning is displayed.

scenarios.title: Continue the session
scenarios.description: Verify that the user can continue the session from the timeout warning.
preconditions: The session timeout warning is displayed.
expected_results: The user can continue the session.

scenarios.title: Automatic sign-out after inactivity
scenarios.description: Verify that the system signs out an inactive user after 5 minutes.
actions: Leave the session inactive for 5 minutes.
expected_results: The system automatically signs the user out.
